notes.text: A bill's link now opens in the app instead of the browser, with its photos and comments.
A bill's link that is no longer shared, or that only the people in the bill can open, now says so instead of showing an error.
A profile's link now opens even when you haven't signed in.
Profile › Privacy and about has a new switch, "Share usage data": turn it off to stop sending how you use the app.
The links you share to your profile, to a comment and to get the app now show their preview in your language.
